ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/cream pixels dominate approximately 70% of the visible surface, with a low-intensity black/dark-grey central wedge occupying the remaining 30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity cream-colored contiguous regions across the lateral lobes. A central low-intensity 'V' shaped pigmentation zone originates at the peduncle and tapers toward the mid-lobe. High-contrast black mottling is concentrated at the distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible wide, obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 135 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary boundary exhibits low-frequency undulations with localized high-frequency serrations concentrated on the outer 20% of the trailing edge near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning to an upward sweep toward the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark, irregular pixel clusters along the periphery of the distal tips, consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical reddish-brown linear pixel disruption is visible on the inner lower quadrant of the right lobe. Sparse, faint horizontal grey linear marks are present on the left lobe's mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical reddish linear lesion on the right lobe; significant irregular black pigmentation/scarring on the distal-most tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated dark circular spots (focal mottling) distributed randomly across the high-intensity cream surface of the left lobe.
